request.style: English, gentle female solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, soft flute, light percussion, warm and narrative mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The king ordered Ashpenaz the chief of his court officials
To bring in some of the Israelites from the royal family
Young men without any physical defect and handsome
Skilled in all wisdom and endowed with knowledge

[Pre-Chorus]
Fit to serve in the king's palace
To learn the writing and the language of the Chaldeans

[Chorus]
Ashpenaz gave them new Babylonian names
Belteshazzar Shadrach Meshach and Abednego
But Daniel resolved in his heart
Not to defile himself with the king's food

[Verse]
God granted him favor and compassion
In the sight of the chief official
Yet Ashpenaz feared the lord the king
Who assigned their food and drink

[Pre-Chorus]
Afraid the king would see them looking worse
Than the other young men their age

[Chorus]
Ashpenaz gave them new Babylonian names
Belteshazzar Shadrach Meshach and Abednego
But Daniel resolved in his heart
Not to defile himself with the king's food

[Bridge]
You would cost me my head before the king
So Daniel spoke to the steward in charge

[Outro]
Three years of training in Babylon
Keeping faith in the king's court
